thread:
emma_marketing: Heads-up team 1: final go/no-go for the release announcement tomorrow 09:30 PT. Need: one-sentence headline, confirmed docs link, benchmark highlight (single stat), rollout window, and sales routing tag. Can we lock this down now? @ryan_engineering @maya_docs @tom_product @olivia_salesops

ryan_engineering: Rollout plan: start 08:45 PT with a 5% canary for 10m, then 25% for 15m, 100% by 09:30 PT assuming no error spikes. We'll watch error rate and p95. No infra work pending.

maya_docs: Docs are staged at https://docs.redwood-inference.com/releases/v2.2-staged. Final link will be /v2.2 when we flip. Added migration notes and example config for users to opt into the new quantized path.

maya_docs: Migration snippet to include in the email (copyable):
```
{"runtime": {"quantize": "enabled", "quant_profile": "compact-4"}}
```

tom_product: Bench highlight: internal e2e trace shows median latency down 12% and token cost down 28% vs previous release on our chat workload. Recommend marketing callout: "reduces token cost by up to 30% for common chat workloads" (conservative rounding). Also want a CTA for a short webinar next Tues 10am PT.

emma_marketing: Good, we'll use the "up to 30%" line. Headline draft: "v2.2: faster chats, lower token costs with new quantized kernels". Shorter alt: "Reduce inference cost up to 30% with v2.2". Which feels better?

ryan_engineering: Both fine. Also flagging: in some edge cases int8 will need the compatibility flag; I added a note in the FAQ. No rollout blocker.

olivia_salesops: Sales ops confirming lead tagging: the web form will add tag "release_v2_2" and route to AE queue "inbound-launch". I'll smoke test after announcement. Please let me know the final publish URL.

emma_marketing: We'll send at 09:30 PT with links to docs + changelog, hero perf image, and webinar CTA. I'll add the migration snippet in the email body. Can someone drop a perf PNG and a one-line alt description?

tom_product: Uploading perf chart now: https://drive.redwood.com/marketing/assets/v2-2-perf.png Alt: "p95 latency and cost comparison, v2.1 vs v2.2". CSV included.

release-bot: Release pipeline started by ryan_engineering at 1887654360. Canary jobs triggered. CI: https://ci.redwood.com/builds/53210

ryan_engineering: Canary 5% stable at 08:55 PT, moving to 25%. No errors observed. Monitoring p95 and infra metrics.

emma_marketing: OK, locking draft. Final checklist: docs final link (maya), perf image (tom), migration snippet (maya), headline (we'll use the short alt), sales routing verified (olivia). Any objections to publish at 09:30 PT?

olivia_salesops: No objections. I'll verify tag post-send and confirm in this thread.

release-bot: Release completed at 1887654480. Status: success. Full rollout finished.

emma_marketing: LIVE at 09:30 PT 1: announcement sent. Olivia, ping when tag verification is done. Thanks all! :tada:
